## Biography

The Magrathea is a research megaship stationed in the HD 232819 system. In July 3312, it served as the registration hub for the Vista Genomics and Faulcon DeLacy exploration initiative targeting the Sanguineous Rim, where pilots gathered biological samples to assess genetic diversity in the galaxy's outer fringes.
